name: Ananya Sharma
health_summary: Recovering well after laparoscopic appendectomy. Incisions are dry, pain is controlled, and the latest blood count is improving. A surgical review and repeat CBC are due this week.
diagnostic_summary: CBC on 16 Sep shows WBC trending down to 10.4 ×10³/µL. Histopathology is consistent with acute appendicitis. No post-operative complication reported.
medication_summary: Pantoprazole every morning for 7 days, paracetamol only if needed for pain, and the regular asthma inhaler as prescribed.
appointment_summary: Surgical follow-up with Dr. Rhea Mehta on 22 Sep at 11:30 AM. Repeat CBC is scheduled for 20 Sep at 9:00 AM.
